The '''defense of ZA-13''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]] at [[ZA-13]].

==Prelude==
The [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[ZA-13]] was originally designed to manufacture [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] starfighters, which had the potential to be fitted on [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. After [[Attack on Omar|losing]] the [[Omar (Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities)|original]] factories at [[Omar]] to [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] and [[Capture of ZA-13|retaking]] ZA-13, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered the manufacture of ''TIE Advanced'' as a top priority. To that end, a [[Convoy/Legends|Convoy]] Designated [[Rope 17]] was sent to retrofit and upgrade the facility. Only to find it under attack from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] raiders taking advantage of the situation.

==The battle==
When [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] arrived in his ''TIE Defender'' Rope 17 managed to destroy two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], soon 3 [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] arrived to attack the convoy followed by [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] to attack the TIE Defenders. Stele engaged both fighters to find more Y-wings attacking the Plant. As the convoy reached ''ZA-13'' more Y-wings and B-wings arrived but these were destroyed by Stele. Soon more Z-95s arrived with 4 [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], [[Cobra (CR90 corvettes)|Cobra]]. Despite the corvettes armed with a missile launcher, Stele managed to destroy all 4 corvettes. Soon a final wave of Rebel starfighters which started with Y-wings to attack the convoy, followed by [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] to attack the TIE Defenders and lastly [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] arrived to attack the plant, all destroyed by Stele as the convoy delivered the cargo to ''ZA-13'' and jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].

==Aftermath==
The Rebel attacked also included the use of [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|Mag Pulse]] [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]], that could disable and drain a ships lasers on any craft it hits. [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial Command]] wanted more information and found a space station [[RS-32]].

Meanwhile ZA-13, now under fully upgraded and retrofitted was given two [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon B frigates]] to guard the facility from any further assaults.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first featured in the [[1994]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in which players fly as Maarek Stele. The battle is depicted in the mission "Supply TIE Avenger Plant", the fourth mission of the game's eighth tour of campaign, "[[Strategic Warfare]]." This article assumes completion of both "Primary" and "Bonus" goals.
